newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy industrial investment seen down in '97 - Isco.
newsitem.headline: Italy industrial investment seen down in '97 - Isco.

text.p: Investment in the industrial manufacturing sector will fall three percent this year after a 7.3 percent drop in 1996, state-funded economic research institute ISCO said in a survey.

ISCO said small companies were expecting a 10.3 percent drop in investments this year, medium-sized firms saw a 1.1 percent decrease, while large companies expected a 1.1 percent rise in their investments.
Among various sectors, investment in construction and chemicals looked especially weak but was expected to grow in the mechanical and transport sectors.
First indications pointed to a gradual improvement in overall investments in 1998.
